name: Sutrisno Agung
bio:
Sutrisno Agung is the real name of the actor who plays Gendut (also affectionately known as Pak Ndut), one of the main and most beloved comedy figures in the viral Javanese YouTube series Woko Channel. His character is easily recognized by his large stature, expressive comedic timing, and his continuous run of hilarious bad luck alongside his friends.

Before achieving massive success as a YouTube star, he earned his living as a traditional dangdut orkes Master of Ceremonies (MC) for local neighborhood wedding celebrations. During the early days of Woko Channel (2019–2020), when the channel wasn't profitable yet, he famously sold pentol salome (traditional meatball street food) at a local school in Kediri, East Java, to support his family and help fund the channel's video production.
